name: Arr Stack Connector
description: Connect the Arr stack to raw Dispatcharr VOD providers through Newznab and a SABnzbd-compatible download client backed by Mustarrd.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Newznab / SAB API Key
fields.help_text: Generated automatically when the plugin service starts with a blank value. To rotate the key, clear this field, Save, then disable and re-enable the plugin.

fields.label: Dispatcharr URL Seen by Mustarrd
fields.help_text: Required. Set the exact Dispatcharr base URL that Mustarrd can reach, including scheme and port if needed, for example http://iptv.example.local:9191. VOD downloads are forced through Dispatcharr's native VOD proxy so they appear in Dispatcharr stats.

fields.label: Mustarrd Account ID
fields.help_text: Existing Mustarrd account used for job ownership/concurrency of external VOD jobs.

fields.label: Sonarr SAB Category
fields.help_text: Completed jobs use mustarrd/<category>/<release>/<release>.<ext>, matching SABnzbd job-folder behavior.

fields.label: Radarr SAB Category
fields.help_text: Completed jobs use mustarrd/<category>/<release>/<release>.<ext>, matching SABnzbd job-folder behavior.

fields.label: ffprobe Path
fields.help_text: Absolute path or executable name. If an absolute path is unavailable, the plugin falls back to ffprobe found on PATH.

actions.label: Service Status
actions.description: Show the embedded Newznab/SAB service status and connection information.

actions.label: Restart Service
actions.description: Restart the embedded Newznab/SAB service after settings changes.

confirm.title: Stop service?
confirm.message: Sonarr and Radarr will be unable to search or download until it is restarted.
